decisions.assessment: Verb phrase selects food fully cooked. Done is a cooking predicate, not finished-task noun; exact aliases do not erase negation from raw/undercooked. The original beans example and Chinese sequence agree.
Plural noun identifies liquid eye medicine, not the administering eyedropper. Bedside-table example describes placement without dosage or treatment advice; original EN and ZH agree.
Person/profession noun for installing/repairing electrical equipment, not a unit, category acronym, or all engineers. Original hallway-switch example and Chinese agree.
